new.note: Yellow lentil dal over steamed rice with potato curry and a sharp tomato achar, Nepal style.
new.how: Rinse the lentils and simmer with the turmeric and water until soft, then season. Cook the rice. Fry the cumin seeds, onion, garlic and ginger in the oil, add the potatoes and garam masala with a splash of water and cook until tender. For the achar, char the tomatoes and chilli in a dry pan, then pound with salt, lemon and coriander. Spoon the dal over the rice with the potatoes and achar on the side.

r2.make_ahead: Make the dal and achar a day ahead and keep chilled; cook the rice on the night

steps.text: Rinse the lentils and simmer with the turmeric and 1 L water until soft and thick, then season.
Cook the rice.
Fry the cumin seeds, onion, garlic and ginger in the oil, add the potatoes, garam masala and a splash of water and cook until tender.
Char the tomatoes and chilli in a dry pan, then pound with salt, the lemon juice and coriander for the achar.
Spoon the dal over the rice with the potatoes and achar on the side.

new.note: Ground beef and bean chili ladled over the tray with a square of cornbread, the Folsom lunch line.
new.how: Brown the mince with the onion and garlic, then stir in the chilli powder, cumin and paprika. Add the tomatoes, beans and a cup of water and simmer until thick. For the cornbread, mix the polenta, flour, baking powder, sugar and salt, then stir in the milk, egg and melted butter. Pour into a buttered tin and bake at 200°C until golden. Ladle the chili into bowls with a square of cornbread.

r2.make_ahead: Make the chili up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; bake the cornbread on the day

steps.text: Brown the mince with the onion and garlic, then stir in the chilli powder, cumin and paprika.
Add the tomatoes, beans and 250ml water and simmer until thick.
Mix the polenta, flour, baking powder, sugar and a pinch of salt, then stir in the milk, egg and melted butter.
Pour into a buttered tin and bake at 200°C until golden.
Ladle the chili into bowls with a square of cornbread.

new.veg: Bean and corn chili ladled over the tray with a square of cornbread.

new.note: Hard-boiled eggs with mustard and mayo yolks, paprika on top, laid out on a canteen tray.
new.how: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Halve them and mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, a dash of vinegar, salt and pepper. Pipe or spoon back into the whites and dust with paprika and chives.

r2.make_ahead: Boil and fill the eggs up to a day ahead and keep chilled; dust with paprika to serve

steps.text: Boil the eggs, cool in iced water and peel.
Halve them and mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Spoon back into the whites and dust with paprika and chives.

id: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull (2008)

new.note: Glazed beef meatloaf in thick slices over buttery mashed potatoes and gravy, government issue.
new.how: Mix the mince with the onion, breadcrumbs, egg, milk, Worcestershire and salt, press into a loaf tin and spread with the ketchup and brown sugar glaze. Bake at 180°C until cooked through, then rest. Boil the potatoes until soft, mash with the butter and milk and season. Slice the meatloaf and serve over the mash with gravy.

r2.make_ahead: Bake the meatloaf a day ahead and keep chilled; reheat in slices and mash on the night

steps.text: Mix the mince with the onion, breadcrumbs, egg, 60ml of the milk, the Worcestershire and salt, and press into a loaf tin.
Spread with the tomato sauce mixed with the brown sugar and bake at 180°C until cooked through.
Boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with the butter and the rest of the milk.
Cook the flour in a little of the loaf's fat, whisk in the stock and simmer into gravy.
Slice the meatloaf and serve over the mash with gravy.

new.veg: Lentil and mushroom loaf in thick slices over buttery mashed potatoes and gravy.

new.note: Chicken thigh and spring onion skewers grilled with sweet soy tare, a lobby bar staple.
new.how: Simmer the soy, mirin, sake and sugar until syrupy for the tare. Thread the chicken and spring onion onto soaked skewers. Grill hot, turning and brushing with the tare, until charred and cooked through. Finish with a last brush of tare and a pinch of shichimi.

r2.make_ahead: Make the tare up to a week ahead and thread the skewers in the morning; grill to serve

steps.text: Simmer the soy, mirin, sake and sugar until syrupy for the tare.
Thread the chicken and spring onion onto the skewers.
Grill hot, turning and brushing with the tare, until charred and cooked through.
Brush once more with tare and finish with shichimi.

new.veg: Shiitake and spring onion skewers grilled with sweet soy tare.
new.af: Chicken skewers grilled with a soy and mirin glaze, no sake.
